# README field preview provenance

`radia_field_preview.png` is an unchanged copy of the existing local
`docs/gmsh_post/output/raster_pair.png`, promoted to a tracked publication
asset because the regenerated `output/` directory is not versioned.

- Capability notebook: `docs/gmsh_post/em_post_gallery.ipynb`.
- Context: `docs/gmsh_post/README.md`, saddle-coil field visualization over CAD
  and midplane line-integral-convolution field direction.
- SHA-256: `1d9894de7e276ae80686aba5842afa448be7c57379dd3093de3d7e0ca340ff8d`.
- Publication promotion: 2026-09-16. This is not a new solver execution or
  numerical validation; no new solver version or execution date is inferred.
- Existing PNG was visually inspected. No AI-generated or reconstructed
  scientific data were used. Historical baked-in panel titles are retained;
  a future regeneration should follow the current no-in-figure-title policy.

Other README figures remain at their original tracked paths. ESIM's sweep
image is historical benchmark evidence, not an image from the newer spatial
demo. The Simulink image is a saved library overview, not a current full-window
acceptance screenshot. Cubit HEX views currently remain interactive notebook
outputs; a result-derived static preview is still needed for GitHub discovery.
